# BOARD OF REGISTRARS
## April 2, 2026 at 4:45 PM

The Clerk called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: William Houghton, Marc Gagnon, Matthew Normand, Marc Tremblay

Absent: Elizabeth Webster

1. Acceptance of the voter checklist additions, deletions, and changes from January 22, 2026 through April 2, 2026.

*On motion of W. Houghton, duly seconded by M. Gagnon, it was voted to accept the voter checklist additions, deletions, and changes.*

*There being no further business, on a motion of W. Houghton, duly seconded by M. Gagnon, it was voted to adjourn.*

A True Record. Attest.

Clerk

*Meeting Start Time: 4:50 p.m.*
*Meeting End Time: 4:59 p.m.*
*Minutes Prepared By: Tom Hilton*
headline: Accepted voter checklist additions, deletions, and changes from January 22, 2026 through April 2, 2026.
summary: The board accepted additions, deletions, and changes to the voter checklist covering January 22, 2026 through April 2, 2026. The motion was made by W. Houghton and seconded by M. Gagnon.
decisions: Voted to accept the voter checklist additions, deletions, and changes from January 22, 2026 through April 2, 2026.
